reviews.text: I’ve been using Monday.com for quite some time, both in my current company and in my previous one. Unfortunately, their SLA and support experience have been disappointing — slow responses and little genuine engagement when you reach out. The only time they proactively contact us is during contract renewals, usually to increase the price. During my recent renewal meeting, I asked for a clear justification for the price hike. To make matters worse, when we wanted to add the Monday Service app for basic needs, we were told that — since we’re on the Enterprise Plan — the only available option is a license costing €65 per month, even though our use case clearly fits within the standard plan. Overall, this gives a poor customer experience and a clear impression that the focus is not on the customer’s needs, but rather on maximizing revenue.
